rkarte.geheimnis: Psst — a secret is still waiting here. Ride over and see for yourself!
rkarte.dahin: Off you go! Ride {richtung} — {zone} is a good landmark.
rkarte.dahin_nah: Off you go! It’s just around the corner — {zone} is calling.

beschr.wasserfall: Here the water rushes down the ridge and sprinkles a fine mist right onto your nose.
beschr.hoehle: The walls of the Sparkle Cave glitter as if someone scattered stars inside.
beschr.alter_baum: The ancient tree has stood here longer than the whole ranch — and whispers in the wind.
beschr.steinkreis: Nobody knows who set up these stones. Gooby suspects very hard-working marmots.
beschr.aussicht_kamm: From the ridge you can see half the ranch — perfect for catching your breath.
beschr.aussicht_see: Glitter Lake truly lives up to its name, especially when the sun sits low.
beschr.truhe_wald: This chest was hidden between the trees — good thing you were curious!
beschr.truhe_scheune: Buried behind the old barn: a chest full of surprises.
beschr.truhe_ufer: Washed up on the lakeshore and discovered by you — finest beachcombing treasure.
beschr.gipfelkreuz: All the way up on the Wolkenhorn! Only the bravest high-five the wind up here.
beschr.bergsee_perle: A pearl shimmers in the ice-cold mountain lake — your find, your treasure.
beschr.ruine_schatz: The Altfels tower ruin guarded its treasure for ages. Now it’s yours.
beschr.moor_irrlicht: A little light dances across the misty moor — never follow it too far, they say.
beschr.strand_muschel: A giant shell! Hold it to your ear and you can hear Shell Bay rushing.
beschr.lavendel_bienen: The bees hum their favorite song in the lavender — it smells like summer.
beschr.kornkreis: A mysterious circle in the golden grain field. It wasn’t Gooby. Probably.
